get_team_scoreboard.description: Get one club's games around today, the last few played and the next few coming up, with scores where they exist. The quickest way to answer "how did they do last night, and who is next".
get_team_scoreboard.name: get_team_scoreboard

parameters.description: The club to read. Pick one, or reference a three-letter code such as TOR from an earlier step.
parameters.name: team

focused_date.description: The day the scoreboard is centred on.

games.description: Recent and upcoming games, in date order.

score.description: Goals scored. Null before the game starts.

shots_on_goal.description: Shots on goal. Null until the game is under way.

game_number.description: Game number within a playoff series. Null outside one.

game_schedule_state.description: OK, or PPD/SUSP/CNCL when postponed, suspended or cancelled.

game_state.description: FUT/PRE scheduled, LIVE or CRIT in progress, OFF or FINAL complete.

score.description: Goals scored. Null before the game starts.

shots_on_goal.description: Shots on goal. Null until the game is under way.

id.description: NHL game id. Pass this to the game actions.

in_intermission.description: Whether the game is between periods.

last_period_type.description: How a finished game ended: REG, OT or SO.

neutral_site.description: Whether it is a neutral site.

period_type.description: REG regulation, OT overtime, SO shootout.

recap_url.description: Path to the video recap. Null until one is published.

start_time_utc.description: Scheduled puck drop in UTC, ISO 8601.

time_remaining.description: Time left in the period. Only set while a game is live.

market.description: N national, H home market, A away market.

team_abbrev.description: The club asked for, e.g. TOR.

get_team_season_stats.description: Rank every club in a season by any team column: points, goals for and against, power play, penalty kill, faceoffs and shots. Use it to compare clubs rather than players.
get_team_season_stats.name: get_team_season_stats

parameters.description: The season to read, for example 2024-25.
parameters.name: season

parameters.description: Optional. Which games to count. Defaults to the regular season. Ignored unless a season is chosen.
parameters.name: game_type

parameters.description: Optional. Narrow the ranking to one club. Defaults to the whole league.
parameters.name: team

parameters.description: Which column to rank by. Defaults to Points.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Which end of the ranking to start from. Defaults to highest first.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many rows to skip before the first one returned, for paging past the first page. Defaults to 0.
parameters.name: offset

teams.description: Clubs in the order asked for.

regulation_and_ot_wins.description: Wins in regulation or overtime (the first tiebreaker).

total.description: How many rows match in all; use it to page.

get_team_stats.description: Get every skater's and goalie's season totals for one club: goals, assists, points, ice time, save percentage and the rest. Defaults to the season in progress.
get_team_stats.name: get_team_stats

parameters.description: The club to read. Pick one, or reference a three-letter code such as TOR from an earlier step.
parameters.name: team

parameters.description: Optional. The season to read. Defaults to the season in progress.
parameters.name: season

parameters.description: Optional. Which games to count. Defaults to the regular season. Ignored unless a season is chosen.
parameters.name: game_type

skaters.description: Every skater who played, best scorers first.

avg_time_on_ice_seconds.description: Average time on ice per game, in seconds.

faceoff_win_pctg.description: Faceoff win rate, 0 to 1. 0 for a player who takes none.

team_abbrev.description: The club asked for, e.g. TOR.

get_tv_schedule.description: Get what NHL Network is airing on a day: every programme with its title, start and end time. Defaults to today.
get_tv_schedule.display_name: Get the NHL Network TV schedule
get_tv_schedule.display_str_template: Get the NHL Network schedule for {0}.
get_tv_schedule.name: get_tv_schedule

parameters.description: Optional. The day to look up. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: date

list_seasons.description: List every NHL season back to 1917-18, newest first, with the dates its standings cover and whether it used conferences, divisions, ties and wild cards.
list_seasons.name: list_seasons

standings_end.description: Last day of the regular season.

list_teams.description: List every NHL club with its three-letter code and team id, including franchises that no longer play. Use it to turn a team name into the code the other actions take.
list_teams.name: list_teams

franchise_id.description: Franchise id, stable across a club's relocations and renames.

tricode.description: Three-letter code, e.g. TOR. This is what the other actions take.

search_players.description: Search NHL players by name, past and present, and get back each match with the player id the other player actions take. Start here when all you have is a name.
search_players.name: search_players

parameters.description: The name to search for, for example "mcdavid". Part of a name is enough.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Optional. Leave out players who are no longer active. Off by default.
parameters.name: active_only

parameters.description: How many players to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

player_id.description: NHL player id. Pass this to Get a player or Get a player's game log.

position_code.description: C, L, R, D or G.

team_abbrev.description: Current club, or their last one if they are retired.

description: Follow the NHL with data straight from the league's own API: scores and schedules, live standings, team rosters and prospects, full box scores and play-by-play, player profiles and game logs, season leaderboards for skaters, goalies and clubs, the draft, and the playoff bracket. No account or API key required.
